applies_to: future historical backtests after explicit freeze
purpose: Declare the exact predictor sources and fields admitted to strict point-in-time historical backtests. This registry is fail-closed and does not itself admit any predictor while unfrozen.
rules: Only sources and fields explicitly listed in admitted_predictors may enter a strict backtest.
Every admitted observation must be PIT-verified under the source-specific evidence contract.
Removing an inconvenient source or field after model-skill inspection requires a new registry version and new analysis.
An unfrozen or empty registry cannot satisfy G3.
F-002 and historical G1 v1 are unaffected by this registry.

candidate_predictors.blocker: record/field-level historical availability is not yet sufficiently verified
SubmissionDate is not publication time and archived QC-complete public snapshots are incomplete
